rules.sourceVersion: Terraria 1.4.4.9; verified against Calamity Fables 0.1.23 bundled source
rules.reason: The official Terraria Wiki identifies Angry Tumblers as pre-Hardmode Desert enemies, and the bundled Calamity Fables BrambleStaff source adds its 1/10 drop to NPCID.Tumbleweed.

rules.sourceVersion: Calamity Fables 0.1.23 bundled source for tModLoader 2026.3
rules.reason: The bundled source makes Electrocells a guaranteed Stormlion drop with stack size selected by its charged state. Energy Cores drop unconditionally from the pre-boss Wulfrum Nexus and conditionally from supercharged Wulfrum enemies; the snapshot observes Stormlion and ordinary Wulfrum enemies at start.

rules.sourceVersion: Calamity Fables 0.1.23 bundled source for tModLoader 2026.3
rules.reason: The bundled BlizzardSprite source shows that this condition only selects the ordinary cold form instead of the Heat Haze form; it is not a progression gate.

ignoredItems.sourceVersion: Calamity Fables 0.1.23 bundled source for tModLoader 2026.3
ignoredItems.reason: The bundled source defines Coraleti Spear's item behavior but contains no recipe, drop, shop, world interaction, or other item-granting reference; the complete exported acquisition snapshot likewise contains no source for it.

ignoredItems.sourceVersion: Calamity Fables 0.1.23 bundled source for tModLoader 2026.3
ignoredItems.reason: The bundled source derives the Fusion Array from HeldOnlyItem and creates it only as the temporary held item for the Wulfrum armor-set power mode, so it is not independent obtainable equipment.
